# Shirley & Stella Maynard

- [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) — Friend of — [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) — correspondent and close friend · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Douglas P18](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0018)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has won the medal and she has won the Avery scholarship. After Commencement, she returns home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), reuniting with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), though she learns about Matthew's failing heart, Marilla's eye trouble, and rumors of bank instability. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a restful day visiting her favorite outdoor spots and walking with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), who tenderly expresses how proud he is of his girl.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a letter to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) sharing humorous anecdotes about her pupils and the compositions they submitted. She details how she confronted [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) for copying old love letters for her assignment and highlights [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's imaginative letter describing his rock friends.
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to take a walk in the park on a windy autumn day, reflecting on her changing relationship with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). When her umbrella breaks in a sudden rainstorm, she is rescued by Royal Gardner, a handsome student who shares shelter and walks her back to Patty's Place. That evening, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) sends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a dozen roses, sparking excitement and romantic speculation among her friends.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXV Enter Prince Charming

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends a prayer meeting with [Janet](../character/janet.md) in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) and observes [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), who offers to walk [Janet](../character/janet.md) home. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Janet](../character/janet.md) visit the Douglas home for tea, where they spend time with John's mother, who speaks about her failing health and her son's future marriage.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXII Tea with Mrs. Douglas
